[PREFERENCE] User is interested in Goddess Garden Organics Everyday Natural Sunscreen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed that Goddess Garden Organics offers a refill option for their Everyday Natural Sunscreen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Described the "Refill Pouch" program, which allows purchasing a refill pouch at a discounted price.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained the steps for the refill program: purchase the initial product, clean and dry the tube, order a refill pouch, and pour the new sunscreen into the original tube.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned that the refill pouch is made of recyclable materials and can reduce waste by up to 70%.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Noted that the original tube is not recyclable, but the company is working on a fully recyclable tube option.
